name: U-Shaped Pendant Light
desc: A modern U-shaped pendant light with a slim elongated profile, dark ceiling canopy and stem, and a warm copper-tone upper frame transitioning into a diffused illuminated lower section. The sculptural loop form provides soft decorative lighting for contemporary interiors.

specifications.Frame Finish: Copper / bronze-tone upper frame with dark suspension hardware
specifications.Light Distribution: Soft ambient illumination with broad downward and outward glow
specifications.Estimated Dimensions: Approx. 220 mm width x 650 mm fixture height
specifications.Recommended Use: Living room / Dining area / Bedroom / Kitchen island / Lounge
